text: The degeneracy maps s_i in a simplicial set X satisfy s_i: X_n → X_{n+1} and represent:
choices: face maps in the opposite direction
degenerate simplices obtained by repeating the i-th vertex
explanation: Degeneracy: s_i repeats vertex i (the map [n+1]→[n] that sends i and i+1 both to i). A degenerate simplex is in the image of some s_i and is 'trivial' in the homotopy sense.
